metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for Claude Code. 25 sub-skills and 18 sub-agents, plus 9 optional MCP extensions (DataForSEO, Firecrawl, Banana, Ahrefs, SE Ranking, Profound, Bing Webmaster, Matomo, Unlighthouse). v2.3.0 adds a local-target allowlist and proxy validation to the SSRF guard, refreshes Google guidance through September 2026, hardens the JSON-LD hook, fixes AI crawler guidance, and raises audit agent turn budgets.
